from.place: Injectivity of the constant-coefficient derived class realization

title: Injectivity of the constant-coefficient derived class realization
statement: For a commutative ring A, a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme T, a sheaf P of A-modules on T_et and n≥0, ordinaryFiniteClass A T P n is injective. It realizes a derived arrow single(A_T)→single(P)[n] by forgetting scalars and precomposing its Ext class with the actual integral generator. No finiteness of A or invertibility is required.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: The constant-sheaf adjunction identifies module maps from the free constant A sheaf with sections at the terminal object, by evaluation at 1. The integral constant-sheaf adjunction does the same for abelian maps. The explicit integral generator sends 1 to 1. Its adjunction formula and naturality therefore make precomposition after forgetting scalars bijective.

Apply the already proved source-library bijective_extToSheafHOf of WeilConjectures.EtaleCohomology.Purity.Smooth.KummerBoundaryComparison. Its universal delta-functor argument is applicable because T is qcqs. Compose its injectivity with the derived Ext Hom equivalence. The comparison formula extToSheafHOf_apply is exactly ordinaryFiniteClass.
